name: HD 33632 A

planets.name: Ab
planets.note: Brown dwarf companion at ~20 au projected separation; dynamical mass 46.4(+8.1/-7.6) M_Jup, mass ratio ~4.0%, detected via 10.5-sigma Hipparcos-Gaia astrometric acceleration of the host (HD 33632 A is itself a close binary, Aa+Ab now resolved as the imaged companion).

paper.title: SCExAO/CHARIS Direct Imaging Discovery of a 20 au Separation, Low-Mass Ratio Brown Dwarf Companion to an Accelerating Sun-like Star
SCExAO/CHARIS Direct Imaging Discovery of a 20 au Separation, Low-Mass Ratio Brown Dwarf Companion to an Accelerating Sun-like Star

notes: HD 33632 A is a close binary (Aa+Ab designations for the two stellar components); the imaged substellar companion is HD 33632 Ab (orbiting the primary Aa), sometimes referred to loosely as HD 33632 B in follow-up literature.
